title: Hold a poppy licence
what: Grow alkaloid poppies for commercial purposes only under a poppy grower's licence from the Poppy Advisory and Control Board (or for research under a poppy research licence); growing poppies for sale without one is an offence under the Misuse of Drugs Act 2001.

sources.title: Poisons Act 1971 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who wishes to grow alkaloid poppies for commercial purposes may apply to the Board for a poppy grower's licence

sources.title: Poisons Act 1971 (Tas)
sources.quote: A poppy grower's licence authorises the holder of the licence to possess, grow, sell and supply alkaloid poppies in accordance with this Act and the conditions and restrictions specified in the licence

sources.title: Misuse of Drugs Act 2001 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not cultivate a controlled plant – (a) with the intention of selling the controlled plant or any of its products

sources.title: Misuse of Drugs Act 2001 (Tas)
sources.quote: Poppy plants ( Papaver bracteatum or Papaver somniferum )

sources.title: Misuse of Drugs Act 2001 (Tas)
sources.quote: Nothing in this Act affects any provision made by or under the Poisons Act 1971 or the Industrial Hemp Act 2015 or renders unlawful anything done in accordance with any such provision
